observations: Photo 0: A black rectangular power bank held in hand, showing heavy scratches and scuffs on the surface. The brand 'itel' is visible on the right side.
Photo 1: The back of the power bank, showing text including '30000mAh', 'RoHS', 'CE', and other regulatory marks. The surface is also scratched.

Photo 2: The power bank lying flat next to a black cable with a USB-A connector on one end and a micro-USB connector on the other. The power bank's surface shows the same heavy wear as in previous photos.
No ports are visible in any photo. The seller claims one of three USB ports is not working, but no photo shows the ports or their condition.

A video demonstrating the power bank charging a device to verify output and battery health.
A video showing the power bank being charged to verify input functionality and safety.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as an itel 30000mAh power bank, but critical claims about port functionality and battery health cannot be verified from the photos. The heavy wear raises safety and performance concerns. Without proof of working ports and battery condition, the item cannot be priced accurately.
